The exact share vector is not a single set of fractions - it is a one-parameter family in the resolution profile (q_0, q_1, Q_2); the claim's request for 'the' stationary shares is only well-posed once a maturity regime is fixed, so both named regimes (TR1'-like and T-DEEP-like) and the mature limit are reported. 2. TR1'-like was modeled two ways (q_0 = q_1 = 1/2 and q_1 = 1) since the claim does not pin the depth-0 vs depth-1 split; the depth-2-cells-free conclusion holds in both. 3. 'F_rho proportional to charge share x total flow' and constant per-region D_rho were taken at face value; if D_rho also scales with share the congestion thresholds shift but the ORDERING (by share) is unchanged. 4. The F1 chi-square 16.38 on 8 dof (p ~ 0.037) is mildly high for one seeded draw but the shares law is exact by construction and all 20 per-region z-scores are within 1.8 sigma. 5. The congestion-order answer 'depth-1 first, depth-2 last' is only strict during the immature phase (q_1 > 0); the mature fixture has a degenerate simultaneous-congestion point at N = 9*Gamma - this equalization (charging drains the no-repeat subtrees away from their depth-1 ancestors) is a structural feature of the 10-marker map worth recording. 6. Sources are the round documents in this repo (R65 report, R68 package); no independent verification of the frozen fixture beyond the cited lines.
corrected_form: (a) Charge-share vector of the 10 regions under uniform symbols, resolution profile (q_0, q_1, Q_2): s_root = q_0 exactly (root receives only resolution-0 records - no deeper cylinder charges past its depth-1 ancestor); s_{each of the 3 depth-1 cells} = q_1/3 + Q_2/9; s_{each of the 6 mapped depth-2 cells} = Q_2/9. Mature limit: (0; 1/9 x3; 1/9 x6) - the fixture equalizes the 9 non-root regions. (b) Congestion at N > Gamma/s_rho (NOT 9*Gamma/s_rho): depth-1 cells congest no later than mapped depth-2 cells (gap q_1/3, strict iff q_1 > 0), root's rank set by q_0; at maturity all 9 non-root regions congest SIMULTANEOUSLY at N = 9*Gamma and root never does. Full-map congestion threshold: N > Gamma/s_min = 9*Gamma at maturity (the claim's '9*Gamma/(min share)' double-applies the 9 and would give 81*Gamma). d*(N) = log3(N/Gamma) stands as the general-depth law; the frozen depth-<=2 map saturates once d* > 2. VARIATION_DERIVED: lapse ordered by charge share, freer = smaller share; Phi(depth-2 mapped) >= Phi(depth-1) always, equality (EQUALIZES among the 9 non-root regions) exactly at q_1 = 0. (c) rho_rec(depth-d cylinder) = N_{>=d} in expectation, uniform across cylinders at each depth; E[rho_rec(d)]/N = P(ell >= d); bounded-resolution two-regime form: P(ell >= d) for d <= 2, 0 for d >= 3 (flat N then cliff at full maturity).
derivation_summary: Setup grounded in repo: 10-marker A13R fixture = root + 3 depth-1 + 6 no-repeat depth-2 words (OD0_R65_REPORT.md:16); charging to the smallest containing inherited prefix region (OD0_R65_REPORT.md:22; nearest-mapped-ancestor rule in OD0_CLAUDE_CODE_PACKAGE_R68_TR1_PRIME_PREMISE_ROUND_v0_1.md:61); F1/F2/F3 definitions and registered d* ~ log3(N/Gamma) at lines 71/73/75 of that package. (a) F1 occupancy: with uniform symbols, E[records of resolution >= d in a given depth-d cylinder] = N_{>=d}/3^d exactly (linearity + exchangeability) - CONFIRMED. Charge-share vector: parametrize by the resolution profile q_0 = P(ell=0), q_1 = P(ell=1), Q_2 = P(ell>=2). Nearest-ancestor charging gives EXACTLY: s_root = q_0 (root receives ONLY depth-0 records - nothing charges up past depth 1, a small correction to the claim's 'root gets depth-0 symbols + ...'); s_{each depth-1 cell} = q_1/3 + Q_2/9 (own depth-1 share + its repeat-digit subtree aa*, which carries 1/9 of all deep records); s_{each mapped depth-2 cell} = Q_2/9 (own subtree, nothing else - confirmed). Sum = 1 identically. Mature/T-DEEP-like limit (Q_2=1): shares = (0; 1/9,1/9,1/9; 1/9 x6) - the fixture EQUALIZES all 9 non-root regions and starves root. TR1'-like (q_0=q_1=1/2): (1/2; 1/6 x3; 0 x6). Mixed thirds: (1/3; 4/27 x3; 1/27 x6). (b) F2: region rho congests when s_rho*N > Gamma, i.e. N > Gamma/s_rho. Congestion order = decreasing share: depth-1 cells always congest no later than mapped depth-2 cells (share difference exactly q_1/3, so strict iff q_1 > 0); root's rank depends on q_0 (first when q_0 > q_1/3 + Q_2/9, never when q_0 = 0). At maturity the ordering DEGENERATES: all 9 nonzero-share regions congest simultaneously at N = 9*Gamma and root never congests. Variation law VARIATION_DERIVED: lapse Phi ordered by charge share, freer = smaller share, i.e. Phi(mapped depth-2) >= Phi(depth-1) always (strict iff q_1 > 0), with root moving from most-congested (early, q_0 large) to fully free (mature); within each depth class shares are exactly equal (S_3 symmetry). d*(N) = log3(N/Gamma) CONFIRMED as the general-depth boundary law (a depth-d cylinder's mature occupancy N/3^d exceeds Gamma iff d < log3(N/Gamma)); honest caveat confirmed in substance - the frozen map only reaches depth 2, so once d*(N) > 2 the whole fixture is congested - but the claim's written threshold '9*Gamma/(min share)' is WRONG by a factor of 9: the correct form is N > Gamma/s_min, which equals 9*Gamma at maturity (s_min = 1/9); the written composite gives 81*Gamma. (c) F3: rho_rec(depth-d cylinder) = (records in it)/3^{-d} = N_{>=d} in expectation, uniform across the 3^d cylinders at each depth - CONFIRMED exactly. E[rho_rec(d)]/N = P(ell >= d) = 1 - q_0 - ... - q_{d-1}, nonincreasing in d. Two-regime form under resolutions bounded by map depth 2: E[rho_rec(d)]/N = P(ell >= d) for d in {0,1,2} and = 0 for d >= 3; at full maturity (Q_2 = 1, all ell = 2) this is rho_rec = N for d <= 2 and 0 beyond - flat then cliff.
